mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% annualized over the previous 3 months signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where CPIAUCSL annualized growth exceeds 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% over the previous 3 months indicates a strengthening economy, which boosts consumer confidence and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where HOUST growth exceeds 5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.3 percentage points over the previous 3 months signals a tightening labor market, which can lead to wage inflation and subsequently, negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where UNRATE decreases by more than 0.3pp.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.25% signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where FEDFUNDS increases by more than 0.25%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) over the previous 6 months indicates strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where RSAFS shows sustained growth.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over the previous 3 months signals a weakening supply side, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where INDPRO decreases by more than 1%.

mechanism_narrative: An interaction between a rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) and a decreasing nonfarm payroll employment (PAYEMS) over the previous 3 months signals a weakening labor market, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where UNRATE increases and PAYEMS decreases.

mechanism_narrative: An interaction between a significant increase in GDP (GDPC1) and a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) over the previous 6 months signals a robust economic expansion, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where GDPC1 increases and UNRATE decreases.
